resolution.method: EAS exact match on 580 MARKET ST → parcel 0291005B; sf-parcels has blklot 0291005B active, 576–580 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1923. resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 736 MISSION ST but it does not join to one parcel. 736 MISSION ST's coordinates fall in 20 active parcels (3706436, 3706310, 3706412, 3706315…), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building.
resolution.note: The address is a condominium today, and the directory contract in the root AGENTS.md defers those: each unit has its own parcel and none of them is the building the record names.
